Correlation + FDR + apex-agreement filter

Source: R/filtering.R
apex_correlation_filtering.Rd

As correlation_filtering(), and also requires abs(apex_shift_med) <= max_apex_shift_med and apex_shift_iqr <= max_apex_shift_iqr. Errors if those columns are missing, i.e. if apex_correlation_statistics() was not used. Conforms to filter-contract.

Usage

apex_correlation_filtering(
  cor_thresh = 0.3,
  fdr_thresh = 0.01,
  max_apex_shift_med = 0.5,
  max_apex_shift_iqr = 0.75
)

Arguments

cor_thresh

Minimum Pearson correlation to keep.

fdr_thresh

Maximum BH-adjusted FDR to keep.

max_apex_shift_med

Maximum abs(apex_shift_med), in scans.

max_apex_shift_iqr

Maximum apex_shift_iqr, in scans.

Value

A filter closure — see filter-contract.

See also

correlation_filtering(), apex_correlation_statistics()
